name: Barycentric Tetrahedral Isosurface Ray Intersection
definition: A method for intersecting a ray with an isosurface defined within a tetrahedral cell of an unstructured mesh using barycentric interpolation.
summary: Barycentric Tetrahedral Isosurface Ray Intersection finds ray intersections in unstructured meshes by reducing density constraints to a linear equation, avoiding quadratic solutions or explicit surface reconstruction.
